text: Great fun game until you get to higher levels! I love the graphics, ease of play. It then becomes pretty much impossible to play without spending money on energy to progress. You accumulate 100 max energy- but it disappears in less than a minute. With the higher value items, it would take days/months to progress. Major flaw, so im going to likely uninstall because I was getting sucked in purchasing items. Which is of course what the producers want.....

This game has a lot of potential. The problem is that it's impossible to spend any time playing it. Energy runs out stupidly easily. It takes over 3 hours for energy to refill back to 100, which is used up in less than a minute and often not enough to complete a single task. You can only buy small amount of energy for a steep price. If I could spend £10 to get unlimited energy I would, and I never spend money on games. But that's not an option so you get nothing unless you fix it. Uninstalling.

Liked this game at first, now each update seems to make it worse. Pretty much impossible to progress without spending insane amounts of money. Some of the icons have been changed to look like kids stickers. Some items evolutions have been extended to make it even harder to get auto orders. And to add to the issues, i had built up loads of energy only to load up and find it had dissapeared and reset to 100!! Fuming!! Whoever is in charge of this game needs a wake up call.

After spending £30+ in two days (stupid i know) (got to 11/12) you still cannot complete the limited time mini games before they end. I find also that when you watch an ad to get the reward it fails to give you the reward half of the time. This game is a con when you get above level 20s they just want you to spend lots of money. Do not recommend at all which is sad because its a good concept.

This was a really fun game until a few weeks ago, when the developers 'upgraded' it. They've changed fundamentals about the game, like how frequently you earn in game currency, which makes it really boring to play, lots of repetition and really difficult to level up. They've been told multiple times that the changes are bad for players, yet they have done nothing about it. It's a shame, because otherwise I really like the game play and storyline. But it's unplayable like this.

Annoying. Far too much effort for too little gain. Too many ads, too much pressuring the player into paying real money for very little gain. Regen takes far too long. When an order is needed, it very conveniently spits out the opposite of what you need. Then, when you do need the opposite, it spits out what you previously needed. The game itself is very enjoyable. However, the bullying tactics aren't worth the effort. I have wasted too much time on a game that could be so much better. Avoid.

It's great for a break from the norm. However, you would have to pay to play it's impossible to achieve any of challenges because the energy and gems are pathetic. Love the game but bored not getting anywhere. I have no intention paying for any game play. Edit I have deleted the game. It's a complete con. Items you spent time achieving disappear off your board. At first I thought I was mad but started taking screen shots. Other players also saying the diamonds you collect disappear too.

Once you get to the higher levels it becomes extremely frustrating & expensive. So many of the orders take forever to complete. You often have to pay to complete challenges in time. You will run out of room on the board and have to pay to put things in inventory. The energy can be bought with gems, when the energy is 10 gems, this is reasonable. But sometimes, for no reason, it bumps it to 40 gems again forcing you to pay to play. If you want to complete the events, you'll probably have to pay.

This game has a bug since recent updates. I have been taking screenshots before closing the app because items go missing. Even when you get 300 energy, you still won't be able to complete merge tasks. There's not much you can do to even get more energy. This game is getting more and more annoying. Also, the algorithm will be giving you the same items to find, and they're usually to ones that are hard to get to. Unhappy.

I wouldn't advise you to play this game. It has good graphics, but the constant pop-ups for purchases of energy, which you have to use to get just 1 item out of a few , are super annoying. The game is obviously designed to get to spend money on the extra items, energy etc. There are more fun games out there where you don't actually need to waste that much money. Don't recommend.

I enjoy the gameplay and progression, and the amount of "move energy" is decent compared to other games which portion play in such a way. But it would be better if max level item generators had their own free inventory space like building materials do. At the moment they can only be stored in the premium currency inventory slots when no longer needed, which seems better suited for items mid-progress as that's more of a pay-to-win feature.

Brilliant and fun game. BUT, as the levels get high, you can only play for 5-10 minutes at a time, every few hours. Unless you pay money!! This is terrible, as it's a game that you want to binge! I had 100 energy, then had to make pottery. I got 16 items in my full 100 energy (that I waited hours for it to refresh), due to the 6 touches per item... 16 items made after waiting 3 hours? Maybe double the energy after level 25, or add energy chest orders. Is anything being done to help this?

Many reviews say you can't pass level 21, well I'm level 31. Game is great, i don't mind freeze time, but those long ones are a bit much, especially because there is no clock. But it's not an easy game, it's quite tactical on what to keep on the small board to have enough space, choose which task to complete next based on your needs and space left on the board. They do give gems for free quite frequently although it's annoying that one of the daily tasks is always to spend them 🙄 great game

Great game but first, you should give more energy and I'm taking into account the ones you get with adds. After a while when you get to difficult levels items are more complicated and buildings are more expensive. I'm starting to lose interest if I have to wait for two days to finally merge the required items. And second, why do you allow building purchases if you didn't make them in the game yet?? I just spent 19000 coins to be greeted with coming soon. That's just poor care of your consumers.

I love the game. As you move up the levels however, it's almost impossible to complete your daily target because you can't fulfil the orders with the amount of energy available in one day. Also, I've been trying for a month now to get the mysterious fossil- haven't touched any other order. All my energy has just gone into the sea shell bucket. I've had two letters to merge into a map but wow! Still no fossil. Must be at least 4800 energy spent on that! And it's supposed to be a level 1 item.

Yeah, it's a nice game that you want to play a little longer period of time not only 10 minutes until the energy it's gone, but it goes so fast and it comes back so slowly .. I guess just because the producers want to spend your money on a game, but no thanks. I rather watch ads for some more energy. After all its nice,but annoying at some point to merge 1000 time the same things ... But how the energy it's working its more annoying than anything.

I've got up to level 23 and now stuck because I'm waiting for them to add more to the game. Its a decent merge game but your board gets full of stuff quickly because you've got 4 or 5 different themes with different levels of merged objects. Providing you have a bit of patience and can put down your phone for a bit, you can get through the game without having to use your money

Very quickly becomes stagnent as energy doesnt get you very far progress wise & everything gets very expensive. It's not worth paying real money unless you want to shell out everyday. And the pop ups! Never known a game have so many. 4 just to let me know I've run out of energy. Half a dozen when I log in. The graphics are good but I dont think I will be playing for much longer.

I played this game for over a week and enjoyed it, but I’ve decided to uninstall. When you progress and the tasks become more complex,collecting items can cost hundreds of energy points. The game offers limited energy replenishment—four ads per day for 25 energy each or waiting three hours. At higher levels, your energy bar depletes in minutes, and you're bombarded with offers to buy gems and energy. It feels more like pay-to-play-at-all than pay-to-win game.

I love this game, it's the best merge two game I've played so far. The art style is so cute and it feels satisfying when you finally get the tools needed and build up the town. However, I knocked a star because it's just not affordable. The amount of gems you get doesn't justify the price. And they get used up so quickly because of how expensive some of the gem-only items are. It would be MUCH better with a monthly sub that gives daily gems. I'd love to support the devs. Please consider it.

I'm on the fence about this game. Great concept, but as I progress, I find I have like 5 mins of gameplay before running out of energy. I then have to wait for 3hrs to get my next 5 mins of play, or buy more energy. Which, when I do, I'm really pleased for 15 mins, then I run out of energy again! It's quite frustrating, there's the odd time I get a good run on the game if I complete levels or have enough diamonds saved to purchase more energy. I'd say it needs £5 a day spent to enjoy playing.

I did really like the game. Unfortunately it's quite hard to play it now. Once I open the app to play, I must wait, because it has to recharge items I need to complete orders. I can't get watermelon for over a week now. There is no enough place on the grid. Arctic event so disappointing. I used to get some diamonds and more energy after completing the level, but nothing now. 100 energy isn't enough to complete even one order. To buy diamonds are overpriced. Not happy with the game anymore!

Good at first but the amount of energy given is not enough up the levels, you should IMO be able to complete at least one order.Appreciate it's designed to keep you coming back/ pay, but this is so slow that you think why bother, you can't ever succeed in the timed events. i feel you are losing a lot of dedicated players this way. Alongside the obscene amount of pop ups (like that scene from scary movie!) Would be nice if this was taken on board and changed due to no. of similar reviews.

Have been a 'traveller' for a good couple of years and always enjoyed the game. the recent update and changes to auto orders/producers is shocking and makes daily goals and challenges unachievable without spending money - even doing so you may not even hit the target! Having rewarding auto orders made the game enjoyable and exciting. previously I would have made in app purchases along the way to help me progress, now there is no way I will do this as it's hopeless! Poor move by developers!

It's a good game, however, there are far too many pop ups each time you run out of energy. This disrupts playing the game continually & is super frustrating. Please reduce the pop ups to 1 that you can click on and find all the various options to increase your energy. At this point, the game feels not worth it because of the constant interruptions.

Takes far too long/energy to merge to achieve goals. can't even play 2mins before energy runs out, then you get about four pop-ups to buy energy each time. No ads is great, but the pop-ups are just as annoying, one or two fine.. but four. If people want to buy energy, they will know where to go as there are 3 options at the side of the screen on the home screen with a timer to let you know how long you have left for the deals

I really enjoyed this game at first but it's pretty frustrating the further you get along. On level 45 now but I pretty much know I'll spend 5 mins, not even that sometimes, and then have to leave for quite a while to allow for reloading. You would have to spend quite a lot of money to really get into the game. Such a shame. My mum has deleted the app now for the same reason.

Gets boring very quick. You're expected to make purchases pretty quickly, as far as I can see, else it will take you days to advance at all. I'm on level 31 and advancing has basically become impossible without purchasing diamonds etc. Very bored now. Will not be continuing on with the game when so many better games, which are exactly the same, are out there.

I liked it at first, however to expect people to pay money and then limit how we use it is crazy to me . For example you have enough energy to keep reloading but you have to wait for the item to recharge . Waiting whilst playing a game is ridiculous. Action action action is what keeps buyers entranced . That 30 seconds to a minute im waiting to recharge ,i lose interest .Do better, please . Im not playing this game until that ridiculous feature is updated to unlimited !!

I absolutely loved this game. I've been playing it for almosta year. Unfortunately the more you progress the less likely you can achieve even basic goals without spending real money, which is very sad. The higher my level the more I had to spend. 4 months ago spending £20-40 a month to meet the goal now changed into £200-300 and I simply can't afford keeping up with that level of game. I don't feel joy anymore playing it as it takes away more than it gives. Sadly most of games now are like this.

A horrible game. Not the gameplay itself, that's very fun, but the energy system is horrendous. Everything takes energy, and you get 100 which ends in 1 minute. You get one minute of daily gameplay, and in-app purchases are pushed like crazy, and you cannot have a nice time without paying for it. Would not recommend unless you're willing to pay several hundred pounds to receive a reasonable amount of content

I quite enjoyed this game when I first downloaded it a long time ago. but I've noticed the last few months that there is a ridiculous amount of pop ups when you first open the game and now especially when you run out of energy - had 6 separate pop ups about buying/gaining more energy in one go. completely unnecessary.

It's actually a good game, but the app developers are money grabbing because the in-app purchases are extortionate! In order to really progress in the game you have to make endless purchases because the 100 daily energy allowance is nowhere near enough! You're inadvertently forced to make purchases in order to make relatively good progress, and in this time of austerity it's really not worth it. Unfortunately, I'll be deleting the app because it's now no longer enjoyable 🙃

Been playing for ages as it used to be good. However the more you progress the longer it takes to get anywhere which makes it boring. At level 89 I couldn't tell you the last time the progress bar actually moved. Energy takes too long to regenerate so in reality I can play for a few minutes then back at 0. Now deleting as other games give energy more freely and generates more quicker. Just wants you to spend money now. It's freezing a lot too.

Game loading time is so long that it goes sometimes 5 minutes and haven't been able to play for over a month. And now it's lost so much of my data! Bubbles- dont always pop after watching ad & buttons to pay/watch ad are grey. I have to wait till it pops instead. frustrating. Mysterious fossil had been on my to do list for over a month now. no idea where to get it. Contact link sends me to FAQ instead

Ohh this game was so amazing for a few months, great graphics, fast pace, addictive rewards & storyline, loveable characters, immersive interactions... and the greatest gameplay.... all of this happened nicely until level 45... then the pace slowed down to a point where I'm questioning my sanity, wether I even bother opening it any more ,😭😭😭 such a sad loss to my day ... I'm really going to miss this game on the day I retire it... and that will be very soon I feel. it's just not the same now.

Great game at first, but after the first 20 levels or so it gets so much slower to get anything done without spending money. I open the app and can spawn/merge items for about 2 minutes before I run out of energy and have to wait 3 hours for it to top up again. So a single order which used to take 2 minutes to complete now takes up to several days. And even if you do spend money on energy/gems that doesn't last long either. Honestly I don't see the point amymore

Game crashed after 3 days This is a good merging game with great graphics, although the story isn't that engaging and it's all designed to part you from your money with 'energy' that gets used up quickly and items having to 'recharge'. (The merging chains are also ridiculously long.) After three days playing the game crashed and wouldn't load, ao a total waste of money and time as I don't want to have to start from the beginning again having got to level 22.

Unfortunately I have had to change my rating. You can only play this game for a few minutes every few hours because the energy disappears so quickly without actually getting anywhere in the game. It's so disappointing and hard. Great concept and could of been such a great game but it's just pointless to me now as takes so long to get an item you need. Needs a huge update to fix the problems that all the reviews mention.

Only way you can do most of requests is by buying lives. Many times you need 1 item from the producer and you can use your full 100 energy and not get it as it spits out the other item(s). As soon as you need the other item(s) from the producer it then spits out the complete opposite. Basically, just wanting you to spend money on what could be a good free game

Started off loads of fun. Really addictive, great fun. Now I'm on level 22 n I think I'm on the verge of deleting it, it's become unplayable. I get the energy thing alot of games have that but having to wait for items to recharge totally spoils what could be a really great game. There no timer so you dont know how long it's going to take it just looks like it's going to be hours and hours til you can use it just to get a handful of items and them it recharges again. Ruins the game

I thought this game wouldn't be that good and I only downloaded it to get a prize for another game. As I played it I found that I quite enjoyed it and continued to play even after I got my prize. However, I spend a lot of my energy getting the same items. The items which release other items don't give an even amount. For example the Metal Gazebo gives out seeds & water but I always get more water than I get seeds which is quite frustrating especially when I need the seeds to fill an order.

When I first downloaded this game I LOVED IT! I spent a little money to be able to carry on playing as I enjoyed it so much. NOW ...it's just no fun. It is almost impossible to play and get gift UNLESS you pay! I'm sorry, you where on to a really good thing at the start of this game but I'm now going to uninstall it, it's just no fun when you make it so hard to progress. If you'd left it like it was I would of spent the odd £5 ..NOW you get NOTHING!

Just started playing and enjoying it so far.Relaxing to play🙂 Been playing for a few days now and loving the game, just wish there were more than 100 free energy every day. I'd be happy to watch more videos to get more energy and diamonds because I can't really afford to spend money to get extra so don't get to play the game as long as I'd like to.🙂

Not enjoyable since the recent update. There are daily and weekly challenges, which are now impossible to achieve since they reduced the coins for auto-orders. The only way to achieve them is to spend money. I used to spend a little bit for special events, but there's no point now when the end goals are so far out of reach. In addition, the game owners/developers do not communicate much with their player base, you're pretty much left on your own to figure things out using the in-game info.

Great game. Yes you only get 100 energy but for me that's enough as most of the time the objects are recharging that's the only frustration I have. There are plenty of options to gain more energy. By either watching an ad for 25 energy or buy some with gems. Could so with more slots for objects that are no longer in use. For me its a good way to chill for 10mins.

I loved the game, however, now I've reached over level 50 it's almost unplayable without spending money. Base Energy doesn't increase with your level, so you end up using all 100 energy within a couple of minutes. Thing is, it doesn't even get you close to filling an order. I'm currently needing one of the rarer drop items, and I used all 100 with no sign of it dropping. Gems are scarce at higher level too, so can't buy energy with those. Really disappointed.

Meh standard merger game. I dislike that games like this have energy to slow down your play or force you to pay for more play time. The fact that travel time increases the cost every time (10 diamonds first time, then 20, then 40 etc) is appalling Was really enjoying it (despite the hand-holdy tutorial but I get it) but will be uninstslling now, I refuse to spend money on a mobile game and forcing a timer for it is not on there are ads in game make your money from that

I enjoyed the game at first, then it became harder, which is fine, but I'm at a stage now where it is completely ridiculous to complete orders and can take days, based on the amount of energy needed. Sadly despite your level, your energy is capped at 100, there is no way to speed this up to max energy faster, all events there is no possible chance of completing unless you pay for energy, so you never really get to benefit from such events other than lesser rewards, to many popups also.

If you do not want to spend money then do not play this game, without paying for energy you'll use up your energy in 5 minutes and will have to wait hours for it to reload. One thing i suggest is an undo button that could cost coins rather than diamonds or energy as there have been so many times that I have accidentally merged something and it's something that has taken 1000+ energy to get only to just make a huge mistake and end up with the max item that is never needed it's beyond irritating.

Quickly becomes boring and tedious. Not enough energy supplied to fill the orders, and some items require lots of merging before you can play on. Prices are ludicrous for diamonds and levelling up is a non starter. Can take 3 days to merge 30 items into one order and there's no way to bin orders you can't make. I've been waiting on a "special" fossil appearing for far too long and it seems to progress you need to spend. Either refill the energy faster or allow us to bin unattainable orders!!

To get anywhere, you've got to throw a lot of money at it. I spent over £500 last month, and I could have easily spent more. I got to level 108 after 2 years, but today I decided enough is enough, and I've uninstalled it. It's a shame because it's a great game, but the costs for energy and diamonds are ridiculous. There's lots of free merge games available if you look around Generic reply from developer that basically says, "So what?" albeit in a polite way. I doubt they'll change anything

I used to love playing that game, but now.... it seems to be designed for people who are willing to spend money in this game to buy diamonds and to generate more energy to play that game! Whenever generating products which are random, I keep not getting the ones needed to complete the order! So have to keep regenerating those product generating items, using up all my energy, which sometimes takes days to fulfil the order! Very frustrating!

Clearly a cash cow. Just offer a paid version with reduced wait times and no in-app. I love this game, I really do, but the tactics to get more cash out of the player are blatant and shameless. What on Earth or these pottery wheels? 6 energy for a basic item or 10 energy if a tile or pot fails? This after increasing the energy wait from 30 secs to 2 minutes. What's the point of challenge timers which can't possibly be beaten without a purchase? Some requring up to 500 energy in under 2 hours.

I like the concept of the game but I find that the limit of energy the games has to be disappointing, I feel like I'm only allowed to play for a minute or so before I run out of energy and then I'm either forced to watch an ad or pay money to carry on with the game, it's boring. You just can't get anywhere in this game without spending thousands to get a some fun out of this.

Was good, but now, not so much. After level 50, it's impossible to complete daily tasks as the items required use so many lives to create Even if you do buy additional lives they're used up within a few minutes and you still require more. Always getting cards I already have too, rarely any new ones. Will delete the game if things don't change soon.

Great game but like so many others as you progress up levels it becomes harder to produce the required items. Energy runs out quickly and gems can't be obtained as easily as they did in the beginning so you have to wait on energy recharging (or buy with real money and the prices are ridiculous). Also producing items need to recharge after using them about 6 or 7 times which is highly frustrating! IMO the game is spoiled and becomes less enjoyable once you get over level 25.

The game itself is really fun and I love the graphics and designs, but it lacks creativity. Every single person has the exact same town, its not creative at all. You can't choose where to place buildings or have any say about your town. While the main point of the game is to merge, your own town is also an important aspect, but no one cares about it because all you have to do is just click the green button to upgrade your building and that's it. If this was change, the game would be an easy 5/5.

Has been fun for a while but recently unplayable. When given the option on bubbles to watch a video to earn reward I watch the video and return to game it's frozen and no reward has been given, this happens when you run out of turns, watch video for 25 turns, video watched and game freezes. The game takes almost 1 minute to intitially load. I'm not sure what updates have been made on the game over the past few weeks but ive had to crash out of the game and lose rewards too many times.

A game of perseverance. I love playing this game. Wish it was a little easier to get gems without paying but it's a free game so can't complain! I also wish my energy would refill quicker so I could play for hours on end! Great game. Would be good to have a different version or theme similar to this game so I could play that whilst my enegery refills.

It started out fun but as many others have mentioned it gets pretty unplayable around level 21. The tasks shown ask for items you're not even able to acquire yet. I'm stuck with one task on repeat and it always asks for the same few things. It has become apparent that the spawns are not random and there is a set order of play which isn't enjoyable.

It's a good, time wasting game. But it's gotten to the point where i cannot use all of my collected energy in one go because there isn't room on the board. Like another review says, there needs to be a separate inventory for items that allow you to generate items. Or make the inventory slots cheaper/given as a prize. It would also be nice to be told how long on the timer you have (once you reached a generation limit) and also how many clicks in total that generator has.

Too many changes. This game used to be quite fun and I liked the quick progression. Since changing the blue bubbles to coins and you now have to use energy instead of gems to speed up the items, it's not good. I feel the fun has been ripped out of the game which was my favourite merge game of all. It's now not. I used to buy gems often because I like to progress quicker. But I can't justify spending energy to progress so I'm going to delete it. If it changes in the future, I will be back.

Frustrating! I generally like merge games as they don't require much mental effort. However, I've only had this game a short time and I'm already frustrated with how slow progress is without paying real money to play. Energy renews quite slowly and is expensive to replenish, and for the town building aspect, because of slow energy, I'm already stuck with 2 buildings that I'm struggling to complete. They just need so many smiles, which needs tasks completed, which needs energy!

Very addictive at first, but disappointing the further I got - items take longer to create because shop stickers take too long to "recharge" (not quite sure why that is necessary), there is not enough space on the grid, and to buy extra inventory space costs too many diamonds, 100 energy is not enough. It's starting to take longer and longer to complete orders or challenges due to all of this, making me lose interest in the game.

Good game but ultimately, disappointing. There needs to be other ways to earn energy without spending a silly amount of money! I play the game for 5 minutes then have to wait 3 hours for my energy to re-fill, and by the time I've got the reward for items I've merged together, it doesn't feel worth the amount of energy or time I've used! Game has so much potential but you are losing game players because you've made the game so that you can't play it without spending your own money.

Great game to start with. It soon becomes boring due to unattainable orders with low rewards that take days to fill with no option to skip them. Energy refill takes way too long. Amounts once given for an item requiring a high number of matches have dropped dramatically. Makes you feel cheated and wondering what's the point in playing. Progress is extremely slow after level 50 unless you pay to play, and you'll have to pay a lot! This game used to be fun. It isn't any more. Disappointed.

It was a fun game to pass the time but it's just become more and more frustrating. You get halfway through the daily challenges, then they launch a new "special" challenge losing all your progress. The only way to complete the special challenges is by pouring money into the game unless you have only been playing a few days and get easy matches to find. Then you have the "coming soon" features in the map that you use coins to unlock to find out there is nothing there Fed up & uninstalling!

I used go love the game! Getting to the next location was exciting. Now the goals have become so repetitive at the higher level and always the aim is the same items over and over. Even when you open a new location the items don't get included in the goals so there is no point really. The daily missions aren't long enough in duration to be achievable. I am starting to get bored because at how frustrating it has become. Sad. I have invested money and time but I think that's it for me..

The game is great. Lots of variation & challenges BUT these are getting more difficult to achieve with payouts that don't match efforts. Once you move up the levels it takes thousands of energy just to complete 1 item. People want to play this game however it's getting harder to play. I often spend real money (more than I should have!) but yet I am still out of energy constantly. As you progress you need to be able to collect more energy, 100 is gone in 5min & can't spend money to play daily!

Unfortunately a lot of elements in the game aren't built yet and so they lure you in to pay for things with in game resources such as coins and in turn sometimes pay for in app purchases to actually get nothing. It's highly frustrating and even when dealing them over email to address concerns, whilst they are polite, they actually don't resolve any issues at all leaving you angry and frustrated. Waste of time and money. Do not recommend it.

Don't bother starting this game. It can be addictive but it's also manipulative. Just as you think you're getting somewhere, the "rules" change. As you progress you get less coins for items but new buildings and leveling up costs more and more. I found I was spending money and getting just a few minutes extra gameplay for it, if that. The game is set up to try to get more and more cash out of the player. It's unethical! Just don't even start playing or you may find you regret it.

Love this game but there is a x2 big problems with this game!! 1. You spend sooo much money because you literally run out within minutes!! And they don't give you rewards only like 25 a day plus a couple more if u watch the adds!!! 🙄🤷 2. Coins literally always waiting around for coins to build and your waiting ages!! I don't think you should be waiting for any coins tbh I think it should be the other stuff we work for!!

Up to about level 25/30 it's quite a fun game. But after that it becomes near impossible to complete missions/dailies, events or collect cards you need without spending at least £10 and then some daily. Support is not much help, the prizes you get for getting as far as you can (not very without buying stuff) in an event are barely usually helpful, and at msot you can get about 50 extra energy from ads

Really fun game but I'm now at a point where there doesn't seem to be any new orders. Only orders for things that I don't have/can't get yet...But I can't progress further to get these items...Because I need tool boxes to make the things I need in order to progress, but no one is giving me then for orders now, so I'm literally just stuck in place.

Waste of time unless you are ok with pay to play. I downloaded this based on the gameplay in the ad but it is actually completely different. I waited hoping the game I played on the ad would maybe be a side game or an option after a certain level but after a week of daily play and leveling up I am severely disappointed. I will say it's the first game I have played where I didn't mind watching ads to gain energy. If the game gave you more energy to play with more often I wouldn't be deleting it.

at first this was good but over time it gets frustrating because you need to get higher and higher amounts to upgrade the areas so it becomes unachievable. the pottery wheel is the worst because it takes 5 taps and then you get a broken one you have to get rid of. Good for a week or so but not after that unless you want to spend a lot of money on it.

Addicted game? For sure. You do wonder if it's worth the time. I decided to do the math and realised that to reach the top level of each category just follow the rule of 2^(level number). If the base is level 0 and the max is level 6, there is a need to have 64 items of level 0. Some categories have 13 levels. Which means 8192 clicks (minimum). Unless you have plenty of money to waste and to get to the higher levels, you will need a lot of time to reach those. Not worth the time spent.
